summary.text: Kim Williams represents the 19th District in the Delaware House of Representatives; she was elected in 2012 and sworn into office in January 2013.

paragraphs.text: Williams is a lifelong New Castle County resident and graduate of Wilmington High School who worked for 12 years for a union electrical contractor.
Williams was elected to the Red Clay School Board in 2009, served three years including one as vice president, and later worked as a licensed real estate agent.
